brandColors.name: MC Blue
brandColors.role: The logo and graphic shapes. Never text.

brandColors.name: White
brandColors.role: Pages, cards and light sections, and text on dark backgrounds.

brandColors.name: Teal
brandColors.role: Headings and links on light backgrounds. Colored text on a light background is always Teal.

brandColors.name: Cyan
brandColors.role: Text and accents on dark backgrounds only: Navy, Black and Deep Teal.

brandColors.name: Ocean
brandColors.role: A gradient stop only, never a flat fill. The MC Gradient runs from Navy to Ocean at any angle.

brandColors.name: Yellow
brandColors.role: Tags, rules and stats, in small doses. Set dark text on it.

brandColors.name: Orange
brandColors.role: Small accents with dark text on them, never white.

brandColors.name: Raspberry
brandColors.role: Shapes and rules on dark backgrounds.

supportingColors.name: Light tint
supportingColors.role: The pale tint that rises on an angle in light website sections, and the light triangles of the pattern.

supportingColors.name: Slate
supportingColors.role: Secondary text in interfaces and email signatures. In graphics, use Black at a smaller size or lighter weight instead.

print.cmyk: CMYK values are approximate, confirm with a printer proof before a large run. Where a color lists a print substitute, use the substitute in print.
print.review: The core colors are locked. The supporting blues and warm accents are reviewed with each version of the MassChallenge brand guide.
print.logoFiles: The logo files Propellant ships today measure #17ACBC and #828486. Updated official artwork from MassChallenge Marketing will replace them. Never recolor the files yourself.
